scope: Peer-reviewed measured injection-moulding machine/tool-health evidence used to support sensor and maintenance concepts. These records are deliberately separate from the canonical primary-measured study count unless they independently satisfy that narrower registry's injection-moulding experiment boundary.

studies.title: Study on the evaluation and compensating strategy for the wear damage of non-return valve during injection molding process
measuredEvidence: cycle-level moulding response used for wear monitoring
studies.boundedUse: Supports online NRV-wear monitoring and compensation concepts on the tested machine; it does not establish universal wear thresholds, V/P corrections or proof that every weight drift is NRV wear.

studies.title: Algorithm for assessing the level of cooling channel contamination in injection mold
studies.journal: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers, Part B: Journal of Engineering Manufacture
studies.boundedUse: Supports measured cooling-channel contamination assessment; flow, pressure and resistance values remain geometry-, fluid-, supply-pressure- and installation-specific.

studies.title: Evaluation of Flow Resistance Increase Due to Fouling in Cooling Channels: A Case Study for Rapid Injection Molding
studies.boundedUse: Supports pressure-loss/flow-resistance fouling concepts for a production-used mould; model-estimated sediment thickness is derived and not a universal cleaning threshold.

studies.title: Injection Barrel/Nozzle/Mold-Cavity Scientific Real-Time Sensing and Molding Quality Monitoring for Different Polymer-Material Processes
studies.boundedUse: Supports physical separation of barrel, nozzle and cavity pressure domains and derived viscosity/quality features; pressure ranges and fitted indices remain sensor-, material-, machine- and mould-specific.

studies.title: Corrosion failure analysis of a cooling system of an injection mold
studies.boundedUse: Supports cooling-system corrosion and material-compatibility forensics; it is post-failure laboratory evidence and does not create an online corrosion sensor signature.

studies.title: On-line detection of fouling in a water circulating temperature controller (WCTC) used in injection moulding: Part 2: Application
studies.boundedUse: Supports condition-vector and drift-based fouling detection for the tested WCTC; the characteristic space must be re-established for another controller, mould or cooling circuit.

studies.title: Sensorised metal AM injection mould tools for in-process monitoring of cooling performance with conventional and conformal cooling channel designs
measuredEvidence: physical part quality/cycle and ejection-temperature evidence
studies.boundedUse: Supports in-mould thermal monitoring and ejection-point reasoning; thermocouple positions and thermal endpoints are tool- and part-specific and do not define universal ejection temperatures.
